name: Kana Sensei
source:
You play the game as Kana Sensei, a teacher at an all girls school in Japan. Your job is simple. Teach students and give out spankings when necessary. Kana is an expert in discipline and seemingly has full authority at the school she works at.

Will she become a tyrant or a saint that students look up too? You will decide.

[From [url=https://kana-sensei.itch.io/kanasensei]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演的是假名老师，日本一所女子学校的老师。你的工作很简单。教导学生并在必要时打屁股。假名是纪律方面的专家，似乎在她所在的学校拥有完全的权威。

她会成为学生们仰慕的暴君还是圣人？你会决定的。

[来自[url=https://kana-sensei.itch.io/kanasensei]itch.io[/url]]
